name: actrIIb_bimagrumab_cdr3
source: CDR-H3 excised from bimagrumab (5NGV); the isolated loop does not reconstitute the antibody paratope
caveats: no measured Kd. Scored as a specificity control: the protocol must return dG > -5 kcal/mol. Do NOT put a fabricated Kd in the regression - v2 used 4e8 nM here and it dominated the fit.

name: mdm2_p53
source: Kussie et al. 1996 Science 274:948 (structure); Kd 580 nM unlabelled WT peptide
caveats: fluorescein-labelled probe gives 137-169 nM; the 580 nM value is for the unlabelled peptide, which is what is simulated. 26 unresolved terminal residues are left unmodelled.

name: keap1_nrf2
confidence: medium (Kd widely cited, assay T/pH not reported)
caveats: assay temperature and pH not stated in the source; dG_exp computed at 298.15 K. A 23-residue His6/thrombin tag is present in SEQRES and is deliberately not modelled.

name: mdm2_pmi
confidence: medium (Kd solid, deposition code to confirm)
caveats: the internal dataset lists pMI under 3EQS; chain L here is TSFAEYWNLLSP, which is pMI, so the file is usable either way. Congeneric with mdm2_p53: ddG_exp = 3.06 kcal/mol.

name: trypsin_sfti
source: Luckett et al. 1999 J Mol Biol 290:525
caveats: Ki, not Kd. Valid as Kd for tight reversible canonical inhibitors, but it is a kinetic constant measured at pH 8.0; sim_ph is set to match.

name: trypsin_mcoti
source: Puttamadappa et al. 2011 Angew Chem (Ki ~20 pM for MCoTI-I)
caveats: the 20 pM value is for the homolog MCoTI-I; the structure is MCoTI-II, reported only as sub-nM. Treat dG_exp as uncertain by ~1.5 kcal/mol. A 23-residue trypsinogen signal/activation peptide in SEQRES is deliberately not modelled. Tightest anchor of the set.
